headline: FBI details North Korea's $400M fake Zoom scheme; N-central flaws hit patched servers; SCKit ScreenConnect MSP attacks

bullets.text: New: the FBI says stolen webcam clips of 900+ victims feed North Korea's $400 million fake Zoom scheme. Separately, the US seized North Korean hacking infrastructure and $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance.

Still active: attackers exploited N-central flaws to infect 21 servers, 19 of them on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe. This follows the N-able "4EverAble2Shell" zero-day exploited hours after a PoC; no CVE or fix is on the board.

MSPs (8 outlets): worm-like SCKit malware spreads through ScreenConnect support sessions, a plugin flaw spread malware to hundreds of PCs, nearly 50 organizations report breaches, and ConnectWise has disabled third-party extensions.

Hackers compromised 4,800 GitHub accounts to steal cloud credentials (5 outlets), alongside a campaign targeting 60,000 GitHub repositories. Apify is rotating API tokens and prompting 2FA resets after a breach.

Apache httpd patched a critical HTTP/2 RCE, CVE-2026-119618 (4 outlets). Critical Xen Orchestra flaws are exploited. SignDrop Windows zero-day abuses CLFS for SYSTEM; no CVE or fix on the board. Also: Fireworks AI/Notion (7 outlets), Maersk (5), Turla (6).

KEV due today (11-13): Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. SITCON 3; the last 7 days run 1.08x the 90-day average.

actions: Warn staff that unexpected Zoom or video-call invites can be North Korean lures; verify the sender and never install software a call link asks for.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts, unexpected agent commands and implants.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, confirm third-party extensions are disabled, and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions.
GitHub: review org members' recent sign-ins, PATs and Actions secrets; rotate cloud credentials in repos or workflows, and Apify tokens if you use it.
Patch every Apache httpd instance for CVE-2026-119618; where you cannot, consider disabling HTTP/2 until patched.
Patch Barracuda ESG today (KEV deadline 11-13) and restrict Xen Orchestra and Red Hat Quay to trusted networks.
